mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, EMAIL AS email, MEMBER_NAME AS memberName FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_NAME = #{memberName} AND PHONE = #{phone} AND STATUS_CD NOT IN ('WITHDRAWN', 'SUSPENDED') FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, EMAIL AS email, MEMBER_NAME AS memberName FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE (EMAIL = #{email} OR MEMBER_ID = #{email}) AND MEMBER_NAME = #{memberName} AND STATUS_CD NOT IN ('WITHDRAWN', 'SUSPENDED') FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
